text:
liz: Quick q for @devin @ashok - customer (GlobalBank) needs a POC in their air-gapped DC. They want physical media delivery + acceptance checklist + clearly defined upgrade cadence. Can SEs confirm what we can commit to?

devin: We can produce signed minibundles for physical delivery (USB / courier). Need to confirm hash verification process + HSM key workflow. Also: what's their legal ask re: telemetry?

maria: They insisted on zero egress telemetry in the security questionnaire. Legal wants a 'no beacon' clause. We need to prove agent can run with telemetry off and still provide a supported installation path.

ashok: From infra perspective there are two realistic delivery modes:
- Full operator image tarball (includes k8s operator and CRs)
- Minibundle: runtime libs + model weights delta + manifest
Typical runtime footprint for an airgapped site ~10-50GB depending on model.
Question: upgrade cadence — they asked for monthly security patches vs quarterly model updates.

devin: Our baseline offering: monthly security delta bundles (small), quarterly full model bundles. For airgap customers we can negotiate a custom cadence but it usually becomes a billable ops add-on.

liz: On pricing: is it one-off packaging + monthly patch retainer? Or a single all-included fee?

maria: Standard: one-off packaging/signing fee + monthly support retainer that covers creation, signing, and courier logistics. Add emergency hotfix SLA as separate line item. :moneybag:

ashok: Operational constraints to call out to the customer:
- Signer key rotation requires re-sign of all active bundles (we can do this if they provide HSM access or we sign and provide verification artifacts)
- Verification requires manifest + signature + public cert chain
- No-telemetry builds remove remote observability; we need a manual runbook for troubleshooting
- Delta bundles require a compatible operator version pinned in manifest

devin: Example verification snippet we can include in the checklist:

```
sha256sum redwood-airgap-bundle-v1.tar.gz
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature redwood-bundle.sig redwood-airgap-bundle-v1.tar.gz
cat manifest.json  # confirm image tags and checksums
```

liz: Can someone paste a short acceptance checklist we can send to GlobalBank SecOps? I want something concise.

devin: Quick checklist (ready to send):
- Verify bundle sha256 checksum matches manifest
- Verify signature against provided CA cert (openssl verify flow)
- Confirm operator image tag and container digests match manifest
- Dry-run install on an isolated staging node (no egress)
- Confirm telemetry disabled flag present and effective
- Confirm license file & entitlement token are accepted by install script
- Smoke test: /v1/generate returns within 200ms p95 under test harness
- Rollback test: apply previous bundle and validate service functional

maria: Add SLA clause: emergency hotfix delivery window for critical CVEs — they requested 48h. Put that in SOW as optional upgrade.

ashok: Logistics note: physical media (USB) should be tamper-evident sealed and accompanied by chain-of-custody docs. We can coordinate courier; lead time ~5 business days from sign-off. If they need same-day transfer to a nearby DC, that is extra.

liz: Good. I'll draft the email to SecOps and attach this checklist + sample verification commands. Dev, please confirm whether no-telemetry build affects performance or supportability.

devin: No-telemetry does not change runtime perf. It does reduce our ability to remotely diagnose issues. Support retainer cost goes up ~+15% to account for extra manual diagnostics and on-call time. Will include that in pricing note.

maria: I'll engage legal for the 'no-beacon' contract language and ensure acceptance criteria are explicit.

liz: Thanks all. I'll send to customer and ask them to pick preferred cadence (monthly delta vs quarterly full). If they pick monthly, I'll include the patch retainer quote and the emergency hotfix SLA option.

deploy-bot: Created POC ticket #POC-12345 and internal checklist task  - assigned to devin + ashok.

liz: Perfect — closing this thread for now, will follow up once SecOps replies. :white_check_mark:
